title: Scramjet
summary: Scramjets are super sleek blue jets used by the Huntik Foundation that are equipped with magical weaponry. Their speed allows them to be anywhere in the world in less than four hours whilst they are armed with Power Amplifiers which make up for their lack of heavy weaponry.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Higgans advised that the Huntik Foundation use their Scramjets to transport the Huntik Foundation and Casterwill family to the location of the Spiral Mark. After Zhalia Moon informed Dante Vale of the location, four Scramjets headed to the Siberian Plateau. [Words from Eathon]

The four jets headed to the Spiral Mark, one piloted by Metz and Lady S., one piloted by LeBlanche and Santiago, one piloted by Teien and Focauld Casterwill and another piloted by Scarlet Byrne who was joined by Sandra Lambert, who had a stowed away using Camoforge. However, as the Scramjets arrived in the territory of the Betrayer, he jammed the radios, planning for them to be in the blast radius of the Red Comet which had changed course and begun heading towards the Earth. Dante managed to stop the impact, albeit at the cost of his own life. [The Spiral Mark]

Lok Lambert managed to contact all the Scramjets and lead them into a full-on attack on the Blood Spiral Base. All Power Amplifiers were used and a large battle ensued with Bazela's Insect carrying Silent Soldiers into the sky to attack the jets. [Lok and the Betrayer]

Wind and Shakrit destroyed one of the Scramjets, with Santiago rescuing LeBlanche in the nick of time. Momax's jet was also heavily damaged by the pair, but Montehue arrived in time for them to both use Mjolnir to defeat the pair. [Dante's Return]
